cases.description: Test case where the reader's last character and next character are both EOF. This checks the branch where the method should return a token of type EOF when the end of the file is detected.

Test case where the reader's last character is the start of a line and the next character is a comment start. This checks the branch where the method should return a token of type COMMENT after reading a comment line.
Test case where the next character is a delimiter. This checks the branch where an empty token is returned with type TOKEN.
Test case where the next character is end of line (EOL). This checks the branch where an empty token is returned with type EORECORD.

cases.expected: Token with type EOF and isReady true
cases.description: Test case where the next character is EOF and there is data at EOF. This checks the branch where the method should return a token of type EOF and set isReady to true.
Test case where the next character is a quote character. This checks the branch where the method should parse an encapsulated token.
Test case where the next character is not a delimiter, EOL, EOF, or quote. This checks the branch where the method should parse a simple token.

Test case where ignoreEmptyLines is true, and the reader encounters an empty line at the end of the file. This checks the branch where the method should return a token of type EOF due to empty line detection.

cases.expected: Token with type TOKEN and content stripped of leading spaces
cases.description: Test case where ignoreSurroundingSpaces is true, and the next character is a whitespace followed by a delimiter. This checks the branch where leading spaces are ignored for a token.

cases.expected: Token with type TOKEN and content stripped of leading spaces
cases.description: Test case where ignoreSurroundingSpaces is true, and the next character is a whitespace followed by a non-delimiter character. This checks the branch where leading spaces are ignored for a simple token.

cases.expected: Token with type EORECORD and content stripped of leading spaces
cases.description: Test case where ignoreSurroundingSpaces is true, and the next character is a whitespace followed by an end of line character. This checks the branch where leading spaces are ignored for an end of record.

cases.expected: Token with type COMMENT and content trimmed
cases.description: Test case where the reader's last character is the start of a line, the next character is a comment start, and the line contains leading and trailing spaces. This checks the branch where the comment content is trimmed.
Test case where the input token is null. This checks the behavior when a null token is passed, which should result in a NullPointerException.
Test case where the reader throws an IOException during character reading. This checks the behavior when an IOException is thrown by the reader.
